description: VIGGCHAR v1 at 48,000 gaussians - the tier the PINOC viewer loads. The default: prefer it unless you have a reason.
nextSteps: Present the selected signed URL as a clickable download link. These URLs EXPIRE; call get_asset again if a fresh link is needed. For a download-link request, no shell download is required. Only save a local copy when the user requests it or a workflow needs the file. If local network access is blocked, still provide the returned link; a local fetch failure alone does not show that the user's download link is broken. Do not embed an expiring URL in a permanent page: that workflow needs a saved file. A .vsplat is Gaussian splats with bone weights, NOT a mesh: no glTF or FBX importer opens it. It renders only through the Viggle Splat Engine - in Unity, the com.viggle.splat-engine package (tarball and install guide: https://viggle.ai/pinoc/app/plugin); on the web, `npm install @viggle/splat-engine playcanvas@2.18.0`. The engine plays this server's splat-skeleton motion clips against it (splat-skeleton-glb on the web, splat-skeleton-fbx in Unity). Every asset can also be previewed and edited in the PINOC web app at https://viggle.ai/pinoc/app.
